ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric regions located in the central-medial area of each lobe; characterized by high-contrast black mottling and focal circular spots (0.5-2% of lobe area) distributed within the white fields.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique bold black 'slash' mark located in the mid-lower quadrant of the right lobe's white patch.
